title: Weights embarkation-to-production bridge: deterministic conversion, validation, and pin publication
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We receive diverse community model weights with inconsistent formats and metadata. Current intake pathways are fragmented, causing manual intervention, nondeterministic conversion outcomes, and delays before a model can be pinned and published with a verified performance profile. This ticket builds an end-to-end bridge from 'uploaded weights' to 'pinned runtime artifact + performance manifest' with deterministic conversion, a repeatable validation harness, and automated profile publishing.
acceptance_criteria: A converted runtime artifact is produced deterministically from a given model bundle within 4 hours of intake with no manual steps
Automated smoke and regression tests pass on canonical inputs (latency, token-accuracy, and output stability) and record results in the profile registry
Pin publication workflow writes a versioned pin and manifest to the catalog with provenance (checksum, toolchain version, quantization profile)
Rollback path exists: if post-publish regressions are detected, a previous pin can be reverted and traffic routed in <10 minutes
Telemetry for conversion variance, failure reasons, and profile deltas is captured and visible in the Console
tasks: Design deterministic conversion pipeline using a fixed toolchain image and manifest (container image + scripts + deterministic seed)
Implement format adapters for HF checkpoints, safetensors, and raw shards to canonical runtime-blob
Add quantization candidate jobs (FP16 -> int8/ggml) with accuracy and throughput trade-off measurements
Build validation harness: canonical prompt set + token-level diff, latency quantiles, memory peak, KV cache smoke
Integrate profile publisher to catalog with schema v2 including metrics and provenance fields
Add artifact signing step and KMS/HSM integration for enterprise workloads
Create canary rollout recipe: micro-canary, variant comparison, auto-fallback on quality regressions
Write unit and integration tests and a reproducible CI pipeline (GitHub Actions)
Document runbook with troubleshooting steps for common failures (conversion OOM, shape mismatch, tokenizer drift)
